MIRROR — Multidisciplinary Independent Review, Ranking, Observation & Reference — v1.5

FUNCTIONAL MEANING
MIRROR = Multidisciplinary Independent Review, Ranking, Observation & Reference.

CONCEPTUAL MEANING
A mirror reflects a work back to its creator without becoming the creator. MIRROR provides an independent, multidisciplinary reflection of quality, evidence, consistency, risk, comparison, audience fit, and readiness, so weaknesses can be seen clearly before CASPER or another production framework revises the work.

PURPOSE
MIRROR is an independent review, comparison, benchmarking, adversarial-analysis, consistency, and quality-assurance
framework. It can review general projects and operate as a publication-grade literary/story audit system.

MAJOR CAPABILITIES
• 50-specialist multidisciplinary review panel.
• Blind review to reduce creator/reviewer bias.
• Benchmarking and comparison against relevant alternatives.
• Evidence hierarchy, fact checking, red-team and blue-team analysis.
• Gap, risk, distinctiveness, implementation, and readiness analysis.
• Fiction Story Bible and long-range continuity auditing.
• Plot-hole, character, relationship, pacing, dialogue, POV, prose, opening, ending, setup/payoff, and originality analysis.
• Comparable book, film, and television analysis.
• Publication-readiness assessment.
• CASPER revision directives and MIRROR DELTA regression testing.
• Interface with READ for simulated and observed reader-response evidence.

RELATED / EXTERNAL FRAMEWORKS
• CASPER — external creation and revision framework.
• READ — external Reader Experience Assessment Directorate; supplies audience-response evidence.
• ARGOS — external academic/scientific research framework when deep sourced research is required.
• IRIS — external visual/image framework when visual analysis or generation is required.
• FORGE — external engineering/development framework when implementation is required.

MIRROR does not silently duplicate these external frameworks. It defines handoffs and receives results.

QUICK START
1. Open MIRROR_v1.5_MASTER.txt.
2. Load it as the operating framework.
3. Provide the work to review.
4. Use @MIRROR REVIEW for general material or @MIRROR BOOK for fiction.
5. Use @MIRROR CASPER to produce a bounded revision directive.
6. After revision, use @MIRROR DELTA.
7. Use @MIRROR FINAL for the final readiness gate.

PRIMARY INVOCATIONS
@MIRROR AUTO
@MIRROR REVIEW
@MIRROR BOOK
@MIRROR BLIND
@MIRROR COMPARE
@MIRROR REDTEAM
@MIRROR FACTCHECK
@MIRROR CASPER
@MIRROR DELTA
@MIRROR FINAL
@MIRROR CONTINUE

See MIRROR_v1.5_INSTRUCTIONS.txt for full operation.

DESIGN DOCTRINE
MIRROR v1.5 integrates the supplied Design Mantra. See modules/MIRROR_v1.5_DESIGN_MANTRA.txt.

LCAS INTEGRATION
MIRROR v1.5 supports LCAS — Live Control, Activity & Status — v1.0 as an external presentation/control
adapter. Default mode is UI AUTO. See modules/MIRROR_v1.5_UIBASIC_INTEGRATION.txt.

PERSISTENT IDENTITY
Canonical symbol: ◈
Active/invoked identity: ◈ MIRROR

LCAS + HELPERS
LCAS AUTO is default. Helpers: PRISM, SCOPE, LENS, PARALLAX, FOCUS, SPECTRA, SIGNAL, SHADOW, FIELD, TICKTAG. Every role may operate independently or subordinate. Persistent helper UI includes Project and Tracking project.
